aka.en: Hengyang–Kunming national trunk line, GZ75 (the Yunnan sections)
aka.zh: 衡阳至昆明国道主干线 GZ75（云南段）
广梧高速公路（肇庆至梧州段）

tagline.en: Pearl River Delta to the Yunnan plateau by way of Wuzhou, Nanning and Baise — including the long descent at Zhesang that drivers called the road of death
tagline.zh: 自珠三角经梧州、南宁、百色登上云南高原——其中有被司机称为「死亡之路」的者桑长下坡

start.en: Hengjiang interchange on the Guangzhou ring expressway, Danzao, Nanhai District, Foshan, Guangdong — the working kilometre 0; the link into Guangzhou itself is still only planned
start.zh: 广东省佛山市南海区丹灶镇横江互通，接广州绕城高速——现行零公里点；广州至佛山段仍在规划中

end.en: Fuhai interchange on Kunming's West Second Ring Road, Xishan District, Yunnan, where it ends together with G78 Shantou–Kunming
end.zh: 云南省昆明市西山区福海立交，接昆明西二环，与 G78 汕昆高速同一终点

en: G80 leaves the Pearl River Delta to the west, through Sanshui, Zhaoqing and Yunfu and along the West River valley to Yunan, and enters Guangxi at the Panlongshui bridge. It turns south-west through Wuzhou, Cenxi, Rong county, Beiliu and Yulin to Guigang and Nanning, then follows the You River valley up through Long'an, Pingguo, Tiandong and Tianyang to Baise. In Yunnan it climbs by Funing, Yanshan and Pingyuanjie to Mile, Shilin and Kunming.

Chinese Wikipedia gives 1,400 km: 180 in Guangdong, 660 in Guangxi and 560 in Yunnan. It shares a carriageway with G65 Baotou–Maoming around Wuzhou and Cenxi, with G72 Quanzhou–Nanning from Liujing into Nanning, with G75 Lanzhou–Haikou on the Nanning ring, with G69 Yinchuan–Baise at Baise, and with G78 Shantou–Kunming for the last 92 km from Shilin. The Guangzhou to Nanning part is part of Asian Highway 1.
zh: G80 向西离开珠三角，经三水、肇庆、云浮，沿西江河谷至郁南，在蟠龙水大桥进入广西。随后折向西南，经梧州、岑溪、容县、北流、玉林至贵港、南宁，再沿右江河谷上溯，经隆安、平果、田东、田阳至百色。云南境内经富宁、砚山、平远街，爬上高原，至弥勒、石林、昆明。
据中文维基百科，全长 1,400 公里：广东 180 公里、广西 660 公里、云南 560 公里。梧州、岑溪一带与 G65 包茂高速共线，六景至南宁与 G72 泉南高速共线，南宁绕城一段与 G75 兰海高速共线，百色与 G69 银百高速共线，石林起最后 92 公里与 G78 汕昆高速共线。广州至南宁段编入亚洲公路 1 号线。

en: The Yunnan sections are mountain road. The first, Luocunkou–Funing, 79.37 km from the Guangxi border, was built to the four-lane mountain standard with bridges and tunnels making up 37.58% of its length: 165 bridges and 16 tunnels, four of them twin-arch. Further on, Pingyuanjie–Suolongsi was built partly on a 22.5 m roadbed for 60 km/h, and Funing–Yanshan, 141 km, for 80 km/h.

Within that first section is the Zhesang slope in Funing county, a continuous 12 km descent towards Baise and a 6 km descent the other way. Between the opening on 24 October 2007 and 20 June 2011 it saw 727 crashes, killing 96 people and injuring 136 — on average a crash every two days — mostly lorries whose brakes failed or that were overloaded or speeding. On 7 March 2011 a tanker of benzene lost its brakes, hit an escape ramp and spilled about five tonnes into the Zhesang River.
The approach to Kunming is the widest part. Kunming–Shilin, 73.79 km, opened in 2003 with six lanes, widening to eight on a 40.5 m roadbed for its last 6.72 km into the city.
zh: 云南境内是山区道路。第一段罗村口至富宁自桂滇界起，全长 79.37 公里，按山岭重丘区四车道高速公路标准修建，桥隧占总里程 37.58%：大中小桥 165 座，隧道 16 座，其中 4 座为连拱隧道。再往西，平锁段部分路段路基宽 22.5 米，设计时速 60 公里；富砚段 141 公里设计时速 80 公里。
罗富段内有富宁县的者桑坡：往百色方向连续下坡 12 公里，反方向 6 公里。自 2007 年 10 月 24 日通车至 2011 年 6 月 20 日，这里发生交通事故 727 起，死亡 96 人、受伤 136 人，平均两天一起，多为货车刹车失灵、超载或超速。2011 年 3 月 7 日，一辆运载纯苯的罐车刹车失灵冲上避险车道，约 5 吨纯苯流入者桑河。
进昆明的一段最宽。昆石高速全长 73.79 公里，2003 年通车，为双向六车道，进城最后 6.72 公里为双向八车道，路基宽 40.5 米。

en: The Yunnan sections were planned as part of the Hengyang–Kunming national trunk line, GZ75, and the Guangxi middle as pieces of several provincial roads. The oldest stretch is Liujing–Narong east of Nanning, begun in 1996 as part of the Liuzhou–Nanning expressway and opened on 1 October 1999. The early 2000s brought Guangzhou–Zhaoqing's first phase (2002), Xingye–Liujing, Kunming–Shilin and Nanning–Tanluo (2003), Yanshan–Pingyuanjie (2004) and Ma'an–Hekou in Guangdong (2004).

Most of the rest opened in 2005–2008: Baise–Luocunkou in December 2005, Pingyuanjie–Suolongsi in February 2007, Luocunkou–Funing on 24 October 2007 — Yunnan's first expressway to Guangxi — Tanluo–Baise in December 2007, Cenxi–Wuzhou and Cenxi–Xingye in 2008, and Funing–Yanshan on 27 April 2008. On its first day Luocunkou–Funing had 12 crashes on the Zhesang slope and was closed within 24 hours, reopening a week later; in 2008 the 23 km Guichao–Zhesang stretch was shut for 107 days to add escape ramps, warning signs and speed cameras.

Guangdong's last link, Hekou–Pingtai, 98.49 km through the western hills, opened on 30 June 2010 and gave Guangzhou a through expressway to Wuzhou. The final gap was the 105 km Shilin–Suolongsi section, where traffic had been using a class-II road: begun in May 2009, it opened on 29 September 2012, and Chinese Wikipedia marks that as the completion of G80. In December 2024 work began on widening Nanning–Baise.
zh: 云南各段原规划为衡阳至昆明国道主干线（GZ75）的一部分，广西中段则分属几条省内高速公路。最早的一段是南宁以东的六景至那容段，1996 年作为柳南高速的一部分开工，1999 年 10 月 1 日通车。2000 年代初相继建成广肇高速一期（2002）、兴六高速、昆石高速和南坛高速（2003）、砚平高速（2004）以及广东马安至河口段（2004）。

其余大部分在 2005—2008 年间通车：百罗高速 2005 年 12 月，平锁高速 2007 年 2 月，罗富高速 2007 年 10 月 24 日——云南通往广西的第一条高速公路，坛百高速 2007 年 12 月，岑梧、岑兴高速 2008 年，富砚高速 2008 年 4 月 27 日。罗富高速通车首日，者桑坡就发生 12 起车祸，不到 24 小时即被迫封闭，一周后才重新开放；2008 年，23 公里的归朝至者桑段封闭整改 107 天，增设避险车道、警示标志和测速设备。
广东最后一段河口至平台全长 98.49 公里，穿越粤西山区，2010 年 6 月 30 日通车，广州至梧州实现全程高速。最后的缺口是 105 公里的石林至锁龙寺段，此前车辆走的是二级公路：该段 2009 年 5 月开工，2012 年 9 月 29 日通车，中文维基百科以此为广昆高速全线贯通的标志。2024 年 12 月，南宁至百色段改扩建工程全面开工。

en: No total has been published. Section figures that are public run from ¥550 million for the 23.3 km Yunan–Longxu link into Guangxi to ¥7.967 billion for the 98.49 km Hekou–Pingtai section in Guangdong. In Yunnan, Luocunkou–Funing was budgeted at ¥4.665 billion, Yanshan–Pingyuanjie at ¥1.58 billion and Pingyuanjie–Suolongsi at ¥2.019 billion.

The last section was paid for differently. Shilin–Suolongsi was built by a company formed by the Yunnan provincial highway bureau with three private firms — Yunnan Tongdaxiang Investment, Shanghai Aosheng Investment Holding and Shenzhen Jiuce — which a Yunnan road-building company's announcement described as an innovation in the province's financing of expressways. Its cost is given as about ¥4.98 billion budgeted in a 2012 trade report and as ¥7.5 billion total investment by Xinhua and the builders.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。已公开的分段数字，从 23.3 公里的郁南至龙圩段（广西境）5.5 亿元，到广东 98.49 公里河口至平台段 79.67 亿元不等。云南境内，罗富高速概算 46.65 亿元，砚平高速概算 15.8 亿元，平锁高速概算 20.19 亿元。
最后一段的出资方式不同。石锁高速由云南省公路局与云南通达翔投资有限公司、上海奥盛投资控股（集团）有限公司、深圳九策投资有限公司等民营企业共同组建的公司建设，云南一家路桥企业的公告称之为云南高速公路建设投融资机制的又一次创新。其造价，2012 年一篇行业报道作概算约 49.817 亿元，新华社和建设方作总投资 75 亿元。

en: On the Zhesang slope, after the 2009 changes, lorries are limited to 40 km/h on the downhill stretches, with rumble strips and forced speed-control signs; Chinese Wikipedia notes that a limit this low goes against the national rules for expressways. Escape ramps are lit at their entrances.
zh: 者桑坡经 2009 年整改后，下坡路段货车限速每小时 40 公里，并设减速带和「前方强制控速」标牌；中文维基百科指出，这样低的限速与国家关于高速公路的规定相抵触。避险车道入口设有导向照明。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G80 was built by three provinces as more than a dozen separately financed sections from 1996 to 2012; sourced section costs are listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G80 由三省区在 1996 至 2012 年间分十余个项目分别筹资建设；有来源的分段造价列于下方。

value.en: Known only for Shilin–Suolongsi: a company formed by the Yunnan provincial highway bureau with the private firms Yunnan Tongdaxiang Investment, Shanghai Aosheng Investment Holding and Shenzhen Jiuce. Who paid for the other sections has not been found.
value.zh: 仅石锁段可查：由云南省公路局与民营企业云南通达翔投资有限公司、上海奥盛投资控股（集团）有限公司、深圳九策投资有限公司共同组建的公司建设。其余路段出资方未查到。

figures.source: Yunnan Yangguang Road & Bridge Co., 29 September 2012; chinatruck.org, 29 September 2012

value.en: Guangzhou–Zhaoqing first phase, 46.7 km: more than ¥1.7 billion (1999–2002); second phase, 5.4 km: ¥583 million (2008–2010). Ma'an–Hekou, 36.5 km: about ¥1.433 billion budgeted (2002–2004). Hekou–Pingtai, 98.49 km: ¥7.967 billion (to 2010).

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 广州—梧州高速公路; Baidu Baike, 广州—昆明高速公路; Nanguo Morning Post via gxcounty.com, 30 June 2010

value.en: Luocunkou–Funing, 79.37 km: ¥4.665 billion budgeted (2005–2007). Yanshan–Pingyuanjie, 67.1 km: ¥1.58 billion budgeted (2001–2004). Pingyuanjie–Suolongsi, 61.3 km: ¥2.019 billion budgeted (2003–2007).

figures.source: Xinhua via gov.cn, 24 October 2007, archived; Baidu Baike, 广州—昆明高速公路

label.zh: 石林至锁龙寺段（约 105 公里，2009—2012）

value.zh: 既有概算约 49.817 亿元的报道，也有总投资 75 亿元的报道；差异原因未见说明

timeline.en: Liujing–Narong east of Nanning opens on 1 October as part of the Liuzhou–Nanning expressway.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日，南宁以东的六景至那容段作为柳南高速的一部分通车。

timeline.en: The first phase of Guangzhou–Zhaoqing opens on 31 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 31 日，广肇高速一期通车。

timeline.en: Xingye–Liujing opens on 5 August and Kunming–Shilin on 16 November.
timeline.zh: 8 月 5 日，兴六高速通车；11 月 16 日，昆石高速通车。

timeline.en: Luocunkou–Funing opens on 24 October and is closed within a day after 12 crashes on the Zhesang slope; Tanluo–Baise opens in December.
timeline.zh: 10 月 24 日，罗富高速通车，者桑坡当天发生 12 起车祸，不到一天即封闭；12 月，坛百高速通车。

timeline.en: Funing–Yanshan opens on 27 April; Guichao–Zhesang reopens on 22 September after 107 days of safety works.
timeline.zh: 4 月 27 日，富砚高速通车；9 月 22 日，归朝至者桑段整改 107 天后恢复通车。

timeline.en: Hekou–Pingtai opens on 30 June, completing Guangzhou–Wuzhou.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日，河口至平台段通车，广梧高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: A benzene tanker crashes on the Zhesang slope on 7 March, spilling about five tonnes into the Zhesang River.
timeline.zh: 3 月 7 日，一辆纯苯罐车在者桑坡出事，约 5 吨纯苯流入者桑河。

timeline.en: Shilin–Suolongsi opens on 29 September, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 9 月 29 日，石锁高速通车，广昆高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: Widening of Nanning–Baise begins on 19 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 19 日，南宁至百色段改扩建工程全面开工。
